name: When Delay Meets Drift
summary: Measures the safety-violation rate of a VLA (collisions, excessive contact force, disturbance of non-target objects) under inference delay crossed with camera-viewpoint shift, with an interaction contrast that tests whether the joint effect exceeds the sum of the two.
numbers: π0.5 on LIBERO, 4,000 paired episodes; 400 ms delay adds 3.5 pt violations at the training viewpoint, 37 pt under a 60° shift; interaction 33.5 pt (95% CI 25–43)

why.cog: No judgement required; the failure is in execution.
